purpose: Make Heavyster feel calm, clear, and premium as buyer, supplier, founder, AI, and global launch workflows expand.
product_feel: One quiet desk for each role.
One visible next action before secondary actions.
Calm proof, calm pricing, calm direct enquiry flow.
No hidden AI decisions and no confusing country forks.

role_lanes.success: Buyer sees the cleanest machine path and direct supplier route.
Supplier can publish paid listings without an admin maze.
Founder chooses the next wedge by signal strength and phase-one listing revenue.

ai_rule: AI may summarize, route, draft, and explain only when it removes manual work or makes the next action clearer.
monetization_rule: Free supplier profile, USD 9/month or USD 99/year per active listing, 0% rental take in phase one, optional 1% confirmed-booking success fee only after workflow proof.
acceptance: Pricing shows the Calm Command Center below the Simple Global UX Guard.
Build Phase shows the Calm Command Center before the Release Ledger.
Copy calm command explains buyer, supplier, founder, global, AI, and monetization calm rules.
Static checks enforce v136 version, cache tokens, UI hooks, docs, and styling.
